NOTE: Do not copy this model letter. Use it as a comparative reference AFTER you have written your own letter. Copying the letter will not improve your writing skills!
Dr Travis Wrenn
General Practitioner
Punt Road Medical Clinic
172 Punt Road
Mosman 2088
Dear Dr Wrenn,
Re: Miss Cassandra Kinser, aged 32 years
I am referring the above patient who presented with a complaint of lip laceration, UTI and suspected STD. She requires further medical investigation and evaluation.
Miss Kinser was allegedly assaulted by her boyfriend and suffered a lip laceration but did not seek medical attention after the incident.
In addition, she has a burning sensation when voiding which is due to a UTI. While she has been experiencing abdominal pain, she denies vomiting and diarrhoea episodes. She also reported to be sexually active without using protection and as such may have an STD.
Miss Kinser was discharged in a stable condition; her medical progress is unremarkable. For her lip, she was prescribed Ciprofloxacillin (500mg twice a day for six days), Clindamycin (300mg four times daily for ten days), oral Oxycodone (one tablet every four hours) and Peridex mouthwash (twice a day).
Would you kindly assess the patient regarding her lip laceration, antibiotics course and her UTI? In addition, please follow up on her sexual health clinic appointment.
Please contact me if you have any further questions.

Yours sincerely,
Nurse
